descriptionChirho: The Perizzites, one of the pre-Israelite Canaanite peoples inhabiting the land of Canaan, consistently listed alongside Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites in the stereotyped lists of dispossessed nations. All 12 clusters refer to the same ethnic group, differing only by grammatical particles (conjunction waw, article, preposition beth) and inflectional variation in the target languages.
